summary: Origin guard architecturally sound: frozen final_review target defined once in validation-sequencing.js and consumed by agent-review.js; pr-manager reads recorded freshness_policy.source (reporting-vs-authorizing boundary respected); docs/spec/code agree on the two authorized origins. Two low findings: spec doc lists isRecordedStrictHeadStillAuthorized under agent-review.js though it lives in pr-manager.js; authorized-origin enum re-encoded in two pr-manager functions (drift risk if a third origin is added).

findings.detail: docs/specs code-ref lists isRecordedStrictHeadStillAuthorized under src/agent-review.js but it is exported from src/pr-manager.js:2410; isStrictHeadBindingAuthorizedNow is the agent-review.js one.
Authorized source values ('role_policy','validation_sequence') re-encoded as literals in isRecordedStrictHeadStillAuthorized and resolveStrictHeadOrigin instead of one shared constant.

inspection_summary: Diffed origin/main...HEAD for all planned changed paths; read validation-sequencing.js/agent-review.js/pr-manager.js diffs in full plus architecture, spec, story docs, en/ja guide and CLI reference pairs, generator, design-ssot.json, config.json, amended test fixtures; ran the story e2e suite 7/7 pass.
